hooks.command: command -v jq >/dev/null || { echo 'api hook skipped: jq is not installed' >&2; exit 1; }; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/api/*.ts) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/api" || exit 0; out=$(npm run -s typecheck 2>&1 && npm test 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; echo "api typecheck or tests failed after editing $f" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac

command -v jq >/dev/null || { echo 'api hook skipped: jq is not installed' >&2; exit 1; }; [ "$(jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false')" = true ] && exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/api" || exit 0; git status --porcelain -- '*.ts' | grep -q . || exit 0; out=$(npm run -s typecheck 2>&1 && npm test 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; echo 'api typecheck or tests fail with uncommitted .ts changes - fix before finishing' >&2; exit 2; }
